title: IraqiWalletMockDatabaseSchema
description: Database schema for a mock Iraqi digital wallet API designed for LLM agent function-calling, ambiguity resolution, and idempotent payments.

contacts.description: Payee address book. Allows duplicate names per user to test agent ambiguity handling.

billers.description: Utility, telecom, and municipal billers with required payment parameters.

transactions.description: Ledger of transfers and bill payments with strict idempotency control.

id.description: Primary Key: Unique user identifier (e.g. usr_1001).

full_name.description: Full legal name in Arabic or English.

phone_number.description: Primary wallet identity (Iraqi MSISDN format, e.g. +9647701234567).

current_balance.description: Available spendable balance in smallest unit (IQD integers or standard currency unit).

Contact.description: Relationship: Many-to-One with User (foreign key: user_id). Allows duplicate 'name' or 'alias' values per user to test ambiguity resolution.

id.description: Primary Key: Unique contact record ID.

user_id.description: Foreign Key: References users.id (the owner of this contact list).

name.description: Display contact name (e.g. 'أحمد' or 'Ahmed'). NOT unique per user_id.

alias.description: Optional disambiguation nickname or relationship (e.g. 'أحمد أخوي', 'أحمد أبو الكافيه', 'أحمد كمال').

bank_name.description: Bank or wallet provider name (e.g. 'ZainCash', 'Qi Card', 'Trade Bank of Iraq').

is_favorite.description: Indicates if contact is marked as a frequent recipient.

Biller.description: Catalog of verified bill payment services across Iraq.

name_ar.description: Biller name in Arabic (e.g. 'كهرباء بغداد - الكرخ', 'إيرثلنك للإنترنت').

category.description: Biller category (e.g. PRIVATE_GENERATOR for مولدة أهلية).

required_fields.description: Parameter definitions required by this biller to query or pay bills.

label_ar.description: Arabic label presented to user (e.g. 'رقم العداد', 'اسم المشترك').

regex_pattern.description: Validation regex pattern for user input.

Transaction.description: Financial ledger record. Relationship: Many-to-One with User (foreign key: user_id). Strictly enforces unique idempotency_key.

idempotency_key.description: Unique client-generated key (UUID / hash). Replaying a request with the same idempotency_key returns cached response without duplicate debit.

user_id.description: Foreign Key: References users.id (the payer whose balance was debited).

type.description: Transaction nature: peer-to-peer transfer or utility bill payment.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment.

failure_reason.description: Error classification if status is FAILED (e.g. 'INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS', 'INVALID_BILLER_ACCOUNT').

target_type.description: Distinguishes whether target was a contact, ad-hoc number, or utility biller.

target_id.description: References contacts.id or billers.id or account number.

display_name.description: Human-readable label recorded at execution time (e.g. 'أحمد كمال (زين كاش)' or 'كهرباء الكرخ').

account_identifier.description: Account number, phone number, or meter number charged.

metadata.description: Optional payload containing bill month, invoice reference, notes, etc.
